newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly unchanged on Monday, dealers said.
They expect benchmark July to maintain its recent range between 10.95 and 11.11 cents during New York's annual Sugar Week, that begins today.
Firm technical support was seen at 10.92 and then at 10.85 cents, while traders pegged upside targets at 11.11 followed by 11.20 centsm, basis the July contract.
In fundamental news, Syria issued a tender to buy 13,000 tonnes of raws and 13,000 tonnes of white sugar, to be shipped between July 15 and August 15.
The July contract ended last week 0.04 cent weaker at 10.97 cents per lb, having ranged from 11.05 to 10.95. The outer contracts settled 0.01 lower to 0.04 higher.
An estimated 8,668 lots changed hands on the day.

LIFFE white sugar futures were slightly higher on Monday, but volumes were thin amid public holidays in Europe, and Sugar Week activities in New York. At 0840 EDT/1340 GMT, spot August stood $0.30 firmer at $318.60, while the outer months were $0.30 higher to $0.40 lower.
